hpx_shortcuts.py.summary: HpxShortcuts is a comprehensive Android mobile automation page class for testing HP Smart app shortcuts functionality. It extends SmartFlow base class and implements the Page Object Model pattern. Key automation patterns include: (1) Consistent use of wait_for_object with configurable timeout and exception handling via raise_e parameter, (2) Dynamic locator generation using f-strings for parameterized elements (copies, colors, two-sided options, color cards), (3) Separation of verification and action methods for better test readability, (4) Attribute checking methods (enabled, selected, text) for state validation, (5) Format specifier support for dynamic element identification by name, (6) Swipe gestures integrated into element interaction flows, (7) Comprehensive coverage of shortcut CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete), (8) Email and print settings configuration with dropdown selections, (9) Toggle button state management, (10) Dialog and confirmation message handling. The class provides 70+ methods covering shortcut creation, editing, deletion, execution, and settings management with robust error handling and flexible timeout configurations. Notable implementation includes clear/send_keys pattern for text input, is_displayed() checks for element visibility, and driver.click() vs element.click() usage patterns.
